structure.layout: three-column app layout: left sidebar nav with logo and sign-in CTA, center 600px timeline column with route tabs, dismissible info notice and post stream, right aside with search, server info card and footer

aesthetics.typography: System UI stack (-apple-system / SF Pro) for everything; ui-monospace only for version/commit hash in the footer
aesthetics.typeScale: Very flat scale: 23px logo wordmark, 17px nav and tabs, 15px body/post text and display names (names bold), 13px timestamps and footer; hierarchy carried by weight and grey tones more than size

notes: Elk Mastodon client in signed-out mode: account-only nav items (Home, Notifications, Favorites, Compose...) are rendered in light grey while public ones (Explore, Local, Federated) are full black — a strong disabled/enabled contrast in the sidebar. Single warm orange brand (#cc7d24) used for logo antler, server name, links in posts, Sign in button and 'Show more'. Posts separated only by hairline dividers, no card containers; circular cartoon avatars; action row of five evenly spaced line icons (reply, boost, quote-disabled, favorite, bookmark) with counts. Content-warning posts collapse behind a dashed rule with an eye icon 'Show more'. Right column has a server identity card (photo + description) and a tiny footer with theme/zen/keyboard/sponsor icon buttons. Feed is short (5 posts) and ends with 'End of the list'.
